metadata.native_grid: Selected original sr_2mbathy 2 m ArcInfo grid, not the co-packaged sr_25mbathy or shaded imagery.
metadata.vertical_datum: NAVD88 documented consistently in native and companion processing, not MLLW.
metadata.processing: CARIS cleaning and BASE-surface exports; vessel motion, sound-velocity and CNAV water-height corrections; 1 m decimated xyz fed to Fledermaus AverageGridder 2 m interpolation.
metadata.measured_vs_interpolated: Sonar-derived producer-interpolated grid; per-cell measured-versus-filled mask unavailable.
metadata.horizontal_accuracy: Producer describes approximately ±2 m varying with depth; confidence/independent validation unspecified.
metadata.vertical_accuracy: Producer describes approximately ±0.20 m varying with depth; no per-cell uncertainty or chart-depth conversion.
metadata.legacy_rights_text: Original metadata defers to CSUMB/sponsor. Current original-producer policy permits public noncommercial use with acknowledgement; for-profit permission remains absent and navigation excluded.
metadata.lineage: All Slate Rock products in this archive share one acquisition family. This review releases an existing source; no additional survey/measurement count.

rights.attribution: Data used in this study were acquired, processed, archived, and distributed by the Seafloor Mapping Lab of California State University Monterey Bay.
rights.notice: Public noncommercial use only; for-profit use requires express CSUMB SFML permission. Not for navigation.
